newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Mt Edon shares jump on large trade.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Mt Edon shares jump on large trade.

text.p: Shares of Mount Edon Gold Mines (Australia) Ltd rose strongly in early trade on Wednesday with about 10 percent of the company's issued capital traded.
At 10.30 a.m. (2330 GMT) Mount Edon shares were up 65 cents or 44.83 percent at A$2.10, their highest level in six months.
Mount Edon has 73.54 million shares on issue.
Traders said most the trade was handled by Melbourne broker J.B. Were and Son, seen buying at A$2.10.
Dealers said a parcel of 6.55 million shares was crossed through the market by J.B. Were and Son at a price of A$2.10.
"It smells very much like a takeover offer with the price being A$2.10," one Perth-based dealer said.
In December last year, Perth-based Westgold Resources NL revealed that it had acquired a 6.75 percent stake in Mt Edon.
